description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing organizations within an API version 2 module. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting organizations, with role-based access control and guards.

classes.name: OrganizationsOrganizationsController
classes.description: NestJS controller for managing organizations, including create, retrieve, update, and delete operations with role and plan guards.

methods.name: createOrganization
methods.description: Creates a new managed organization within a parent organization, requires 'ORG_ADMIN' role and 'SCALE' plan.

methods.name: getOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific managed organization, requires 'ORG_ADMIN' role and 'SCALE' plan.

methods.name: getOrganizations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of managed organizations within a parent organization, requires 'ORG_ADMIN' role and 'SCALE' plan.

methods.name: updateOrganization
methods.description: Updates an existing managed organization, requires 'ORG_ADMIN' role and 'SCALE' plan.

methods.name: deleteOrganization
methods.description: Deletes a managed organization, requires 'ORG_ADMIN' role and 'SCALE' plan, with throttling applied.
